objects.title: Salpa pinnata
objects.description: Three glass models of salps made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. One clear model shows a colony and the other two are magnified individual zooids with clear bodies and a blue line in the centre. Original label. Mounted on white Perspex base.
measurements: Dimensions (LxWxH): 2 - Close-up of zooid: 70 x 25 x 23mm
Dimensions (LxWxH): 3 - Close-up of zooid: 62 x 30 x 23mm

objects.title: Bonellia viridis
objects.description: One glass model of a spoon worm made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Features green bulb (body) with grey painted flecks and light blue tube (proboscis) with forked ending. Includes original label. Mounted on white Perspex base.

objects.title: Borlasia trilineata
objects.description: One glass model of worm made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Brown with a lighter brown stripe and a black line down the centre. Mounted on a white Perspex base, Original label.

objects.title: Arion empiricorum, anatomy
objects.catalogueName: Glass Model Invertebrate: Arion empiricorum, anatomy
objects.description: Four glass models (or two glass models plus 2 small detached sections) showing the female and male internal organs of a slug made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.
measurements: Dimensions L x W: 5 - Label Card: 175 x 193mm

objects.title: Salpa democratica-mucronata
objects.description: Two glass models of a salp made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Each zooid is clear with a line of blue glass inside and an internal metal wire. The solitary zooid (Proles solitara) is smooth whereas the colonial zooid (Proles gregata) has two horns and bumpy surface.

objects.title: Beroë punctata
objects.description: One glass model of a comb-jelly made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Clear oval with eight longitudinal rows of raised bumps and brown painted specks in between. Metal support rod inserted in centre. No label.

objects.title: Pleurobranchia pileus
objects.description: One glass model of a sea gooseberry made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Spherical clear glass with eight longitudinal rows of raised bumps. Two metal wire arms with 17 glass tendrils each. Arms attached to central metal support rod. No label.

objects.title: Vellela spirans
objects.description: One glass model of a colonial hydrozoan made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Features a rectangular body with an erect clear semi-circular sail. Brown line running along centre of body. Blue-grey tentacles and a clear tube extending from the bottom of the body. Metal supporting rod attached in centre. Circular wooden base. No label.

objects.title: Alcyonium digitatum
objects.description: One glass model of a soft coral made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Has a grey-pink body with small yellow doughnut shaped blobs representing closed polyps. Clear open polyps on upper section of body. Mounted on white Perspex. Original label.
measurements: Dimensions (LxWxH): 3 - Detached poly tentacle: 10 x 5 x 7mm

objects.title: Phallusia pustulosa
objects.description: Seven glass models comprising a tunicate colony clustered on a base made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Each tunicate has two layers; a clear, bumpy inner layer painted red on the inside and a clear, bumpy outer layer. Red bumps on siphon openings. Frit on base.
measurements: Dimensions L x W: 2 - Display base with attached paper label: 128 x 100mm

objects.title: Porpita
objects.description: One glass model of a jellyfish-like colonial hydrozoan made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Has a clear disc with radiating blue tentacles and a clear tube hanging down from the centre. Smaller polyps clustered around central tube. Mounted on a central metal rod. No base.

objects.title: Doris pantherina
objects.description: One glass model of nudibranch made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Green with brown leopard spots on main body. Plain green horns on head and branched gills on rear. No Label. No base.

objects.title: Thalassianthus aster
objects.description: One glass model of a sea anemone made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882. Frosted white peduncle (main body) with radiating blue lines in oral disc. Clear branched tentacles. Brown papier-mâché base. No label.

objects.title: Tubularia indivisa
objects.description: One glass model of a hydroid in two parts made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: Cerianthus membranaceus
objects.description: One purple stalk in L-shape bearing radiating clear glass tentacles with series of black dots with smaller tentacles in centre. Mounted on brown and green papier-mâché base with original label and additional white Perspex base. No label. Made by Leopold Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: Phymactis pustulata
objects.description: One yellow-stalked glass sea anemone model with clear tentacles. Stalk studded with yellow blobs. Oral disc painted with radiating blue lines. On brown papier-mâché base with original label and additional white Perspex base. Made by Leopold Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: Pyrosoma atlanticum
objects.description: One glass model of tunicate in two parts made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: Sepiola rondeleti

objects.title: Rhizostoma pulmo
objects.description: One clear glass jellyfish with central green rod as mount. Made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: Helix pomatia, anatomy

objects.title: Lucernaria campanulata

objects.title: Astroides calycularis

measurements: Dimensions L x W: 3 - glass base: 98 x 108mm

objects.title: Bolocera eques

objects.title: Holothuria tubulosa

objects.title: Elysia chlorotica

objects.title: Clio borealis

objects.title: Doliolum Ehrenbergii-Troschelii

objects.title: Gorgonia verrucosa

objects.title: Chrysaora hysoscella
objects.description: One clear glass model of a jellyfish with a two layer bell ringed with twenty four long, fine tentacles. Features four large leaf shaped tentacles attached to the centre. Mounted on a green wire rod. Made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: Pelagia noctiluca
objects.description: One clear glass model of a jellyfish with yellow spots on the bell and large leaf like tentacles hanging from the centre. Features seven fine, red tentacles hanging from the bell. Mounted on a green wire rod. Made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: soft coral polyp
objects.catalogueName: Glass Model Invertebrate: soft coral polyp
objects.description: One clear glass model of a polyp with eight radiating blue branched tentacles. Mounted on a bent wire support inserted through the central stalk. Made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: Lafoea calcarata
objects.description: Three clear glass models showing development of a hydrozoan coelenterate. One model is of a jellyfish-like animal featuring a 2 layer bell fringed with over one hundred tentacles of varying lengths. Has four yellow radial rows on glass branches on the inner layer of the bell. Mounted on a wire rod with a circular wooden base. Second model is a clear glass model of a sessile hydrozoan with six polyp-like zooids on a central stem (stolon) which terminates in a tulip-shaped body. Third model is a clear glass bell-like medusa with four blobs around lower rim.  Made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.
measurements: Dimensions (LxWxH): 4 - Base and labels: 85 x 176 x 2mm

objects.title: Carmarina hastata showing development in three stages.
objects.catalogueName: Glass Model Invertebrate: Carmarina hastata showing development in three stages.
objects.description: First stage of growth is a round clear glass model of a jellyfish-like animal with six tentacles and no opening at the bottom. Mounted on a wire rod with a circular wooden base. Second stage of growth is a round clear glass model of a jellyfish-like animal with twelve tentacles and an opening at the bottom. Mounted on a wire rod with a circular wooden base. Third stage is round clear glass model of a jellyfish-like animal with twelve tentacles and a protruding siphon at the bottom. Mounted on a wire rod with a circular wooden base. Made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.
measurements: Dimensions (LxWxH): 4 - Display label for stage 2: 29 x 78mm
Dimensions L x W: 5 - Display label for stage 1: 30 x 78mm
Dimensions (LxWxH): 6 - Detached tentacle from Stage 3: 75 x 3 x 2mm
Dimensions (LxWxH): 7 - Detached tentacle from Stage 3: 75 x 5 x 2mm

objects.title: Velella spirans, Stage One and Two
objects.catalogueName: Glass Model Invertebrate: Velella spirans, Stage One and Two
objects.description: Stage One is a clear glass model of a jellyfish-like animal with painted blue lines. Features a sail and eight tentacles, some of which are retracted as well as a downward pointing siphon. Mounted on a wire rod with a circular wooden base. Stage Two is a clear glass model of a jelly fish with fine blue dots painted on the main body and fine grey lines painted on the sail. Features ten tentacles and a downward pointing siphon. Mounted on a wire rod with a circular wooden base. Made by Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka between 1863 and 1882.

objects.title: Oceania phosphorica
objects.description: One clear glass model of a jelly fish with a 2 layer bell fringed with short glass tentacles. The inner layer of the bell has four painted radial lines. objects.title: Diphyes sieboldii

objects.title: Actineria hemprichi
